That memory is what makes the game feel alive. Now imagine if every time you loaded the game, your character started completely fresh. No memory. Level 1. Every. Single. Time. **That's what it's like using AI coding tools today.** You use Claude or Cursor to help you build something. The AI is brilliant — it helps you figure out that you should use "WAL mode for SQLite to stop crashes" or "never use the ORM for database migrations because it breaks silently." Smart stuff. Hard-earned wisdom. Then the session ends. Next day, new session. The AI has **zero memory** of any of that. You're back to level 1. It might suggest the very thing you already learned breaks your app. --- **Code Insights is the tool that watches your sessions and takes notes.** Like a really attentive friend sitting next to you who goes: *"Hey, you've figured out 12 important things about this codebase over the last 400 sessions.
